settings.label: AMLL word timings
settings.help: Automatically find the song in AMLL TTML DB and use its real word timings. on by default; off keeps the player's lyrics. Original lyrics remain while searching or when there is no confident match.

settings.label: Font
settings.help: An installed font family name, such as 思源宋体, Source Han Serif SC or Segoe UI. The same face is used for lyrics and translation.

settings.label: Size
settings.help: small, default or large, and 小 / 标准 / 大 work too. Sets the font size and how tall the strip is.

settings.label: Placement
settings.help: left, center or right, and 左 / 中 / 右 work too. left begins at the left edge of the taskbar, in the first stretch that has no icons on it.

settings.label: Color
settings.help: Leave it on auto and the color follows the taskbar: white on a dark bar, near-black on a light one. Or give a color as #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.

settings.label: Halo strength
settings.help: 0 to 200 percent. 0 gives a crisp glyph with no halo; 100 is stronger. Restart after changing it.

settings.label: Translation
settings.help: Draw a line's translation under it, when there is one. Turn off Next line to use the translation. on or off.

settings.label: Next line
settings.help: Show the next lyric line in small text below the current line, instead of its translation. on or off.

settings.label: While paused
settings.help: Keep the line on the taskbar while the music is paused. on or off.

settings.label: Nudge across
settings.help: Moves the line sideways, in pixels. Negative moves it left.

settings.label: Nudge up or down
settings.help: Moves the line down, in pixels. Negative moves it up.
